name: HLBANK
recent: Hong Leong Bank 于 2026 年 10 月 26 日召开第 85 届常年股东大会，所有决议均以投票方式通过。同期，EPF 在 10 月底至 11 月中连续多日申报持股变动。此外，该行 RM1 亿高级票据于 11 月初到期，并宣布将 Alipay+ 接入其支付生态。
notable: 第 85 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 10 月 26 日举行，所有决议均以投票方式通过。
该行 RM1 亿高级票据于 2026 年 11 月初到期。
该行将 Alipay+ 接入其支付生态。
earnings: 2026 财年（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 MYR 1,716,032,000，净利润为 MYR 1,242,727,000，净利率 72.4%。营收环比增长 10.5%，净利润环比增长 20.7%；营收同比增长 7.9%，净利润同比增长 14.2%。

recent_en: Hong Leong Bank held its 85th Annual General Meeting on 26 October 2026, with all resolutions passed by poll. Meanwhile, EPF filed multiple consecutive notifications of changes in its shareholding from late October to mid-November. The bank's RM100 million senior notes matured in early November, and it announced the addition of Alipay+ to its payments ecosystem.
notable_en: The 85th AGM was held on 26 October 2026, with all resolutions passed by poll.
The bank's RM100 million senior notes matured in early November 2026.
The bank added Alipay+ to its payments ecosystem.
earnings_en: For FY2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was MYR 1,716,032,000 and net income was MYR 1,242,727,000, with a net margin of 72.4%. Revenue rose 10.5% QoQ and net income rose 20.7% QoQ; revenue grew 7.9% YoY and net income grew 14.2% YoY.
